caption: The drawing features a detailed rendering of a brown ceramic pitcher positioned centrally within a rectangular border. The pitcher has a smooth, glossy surface and is decorated with three-dimensional relief figures: a large animal resembling a stag, a human figure riding or interacting with the animal, and another animal, possibly a dog, beneath them. The handle is shaped and attaches at the top and bottom of the pitcher. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller inset showing a close-up of a section of the pitcher’s decoration, highlighting the detailed flesh tones and the forms of two animals in relief, with the same brown and tan coloring as the pitcher itself. The background is a plain light beige with no additional objects or embellishments.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
